authority: Owner authorization 2026-10-25 for the governed corpus, and the private-repository distribution of the same content to named accounts.
purpose: Decide which AgentOS Skill directories the installer payload may carry. The publisher and the installer must agree: a Skill the published corpus does not carry must not reach a target machine through the installer either.
basis: The published corpus is the reference. The skills array names the Skills the published corpus carries; the excluded array names the Skills it deliberately does not, with the reason. Both surfaces obey this one list.

notes: The allowlist decides what may travel. The confidentiality gates decide what must not, and they apply to whatever this list permits.
The published corpus and the installer payload carry the same Skills. A Skill that is reference_only is reference_only in both.

The import manifest in the payload is portable too: a required file this edition does not carry is recorded as excluded, so the installed copy does not fail its own import gate for a file it was never given.

An earlier revision of this file described the list as exclusion based. That was wrong: the code read only the excluded half, so a Skill that nobody classified travelled freely. The list is inclusion based and the code reads both halves.
policy: Inclusion based. A Skill travels with the installer payload only when this file names it in the skills array. A Skill that is neither named nor excluded is removed: material nobody classified must not travel by default.
